19:32。

谢辞陪着靳兰玦来到特战队总部，认认路，顺便办好了正式入职手续。

因为临时疏散全国民众，总部大楼此时空无一人，全部出去协助帮忙。

国家需要更多的信息。

弄明白诡域到底是由何产生，为何而来，如何清理驱逐。

她加入后，需要她做的，就是定期跟随队伍主动进入诡域探索，寻找线索通关，收集不同诡域的攻略。

官方可以给她提供吃住，住房由她任选，看中就送给她，七险三金，月薪十万。

生活中，可以为她提供保姆，照顾她的生活起居。

任务中，至少一位队友会紧随她身边，保护她的生命安全。

如果她真的不幸在任务中牺牲，国家会保护她的所有亲人不受诡域的侵扰，让他们安享一生。

靳兰玦被这一连串的福利砸得头晕眼花，听到最后一项，瞬间清醒。

“他们就不用了吧……”

靳兰玦面露难色。

“如果他们过得滋润舒坦，我在前面拼命的时候会很不得劲的。”

谢辞平静地看着她，问：

“所以，你不需要我们为你的家人提供安全稳定的防护是吗？”

靳兰玦点头：

“看命吧，运气好活下来，我也不会再去追究他们，若是死了……”

若是死了，那就当他们两清了吧。

谢辞显然早就查清楚了靳家的那堆龃龉，对于靳兰玦的决定并不意外。

只是点点头，正要说话，手机响起。

陆星冶的声音急匆匆响起来：

“队长！您看快直播！直播！”

谢辞几乎下意识就看向靳兰玦。

靳兰玦一愣，连连摆手：

“我可没开直播啊。”

两人打开平台软件，首页就看到最大的推荐。

靳兰玦刚点进去，男人嚣张的大笑声音就在安静的室内响起：

“她就是个P！我跟你们说，今晚我就给你们打假！揭穿那个骗子！”

靳兰玦挑眉。

19:32.

Xie Ci accompanied Jin Lanjue to the headquarters of the special operations team, where he found the way and went through the formal entry procedures.

Due to the temporary evacuation of people across the country, the headquarters building was empty at this time, and everyone went out to help.

The state needs more information.

Understand where the strange realm came from, why it came here, and how to clean it up and expel it.

After she joins, what she needs to do is to regularly follow the team to explore the mysterious realm, find clues to pass the level, and collect strategies for different mysterious realms.

The government can provide her with food and accommodation, and she can choose the house she likes. If she likes it, it will be given to her, with seven insurances and three golds, and a monthly salary of 100,000.

In life, you can provide her with a nanny to take care of her daily life.

During the mission, at least one teammate will stay close to her to protect her life.

If she really dies in the mission, the country will protect all her relatives from the treacherous realm and let them enjoy their lives in peace.

Jin Lanjue was so dizzy by this series of benefits that he suddenly woke up when he heard the last item.

"They don't need it anymore..."

Jin Lanjue looked troubled.

"If they live a comfortable and comfortable life, I will be very uncomfortable when I am working hard in the front."

Xie Ci looked at her calmly and asked:

"So, you don't need us to provide safe and stable protection for your family, do you?"

Jin Lanjue nodded:

"It depends on fate. If you are lucky enough to survive, I will not pursue them again. If you die..."

If they die, then let's just treat them as if they were both dead.

Xie Ci had obviously found out the discord in the Jin family a long time ago, and was not surprised by Jin Lanjue's decision.

He just nodded and was about to speak when his cell phone rang.

Lu Xingye's voice rang out hastily:

"Captain! Watch the live broadcast! Live broadcast!"

After thanking him, he almost subconsciously looked at Jin Lanjue.

Jin Lanjue was stunned and waved his hands repeatedly:

"I didn't start the live broadcast."

The two opened the platform software and saw the biggest recommendation on the homepage.

As soon as Jin Lanjue clicked in, the man's arrogant laughter sounded in the quiet room:

"She is a P! Let me tell you, I will crack down on you tonight! Expose that liar!"

Jin Lanjue raised his eyebrows.
